---
name: Security report guidance
about: Do not disclose a vulnerability in a public issue
title: "DO NOT SUBMIT — follow SECURITY.md"
labels: security
---

Stop: GitHub issues are public and are not an approved vulnerability-reporting channel.

Do not include exploit details, private project data, credentials, device identifiers, or live-capture data here. Close this draft and follow `SECURITY.md`. Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting when it is enabled for this repository; otherwise request a private reporting channel from the maintainers without disclosing the vulnerability publicly.
